name: Shatter
description: Mixtape's whole library at once - corner circles, half-square triangles, a centred disc - and one cell in five raked through with cut slots.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @pick(circle(100% at 0 0), circle(100% at 100% 0), circle(100% at 100% 100%), circle(100% at 0 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), circle(50% at 50% 50%)); clip-path: @pick(circle(100% at 0 0), circle(100% at 100% 0), circle(100% at 100% 100%), circle(100% at 0 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%), polygon(0 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), circle(50% at 50% 50%)); @random(0.2) { -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 17%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 17%); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
